content:
**Mothman eggs**, **perfect mothman eggs**, and **ionized crackleberries** are consumable items in *Fallout 76*.

This article is missing some required data. You can help *Nukapedia* by filling it in.

The eggs of a mothman are typically laid in clusters around areas related to the Mothman, and are guarded by the Cult of the Mothman. The cultists use these eggs to create a "holy oil" with which to bless their effigies. [1] 

They can be consumed raw to satisfy a small amount of hunger with a very high dose of radiation and a high disease chance, or cooked for additional benefits.

When affected by a blast zone, mothman eggs will mutate into ionized cackleberry which yields raw crimson flux when harvested.

Cradle of the Pretenders

- **Mothman egg**

- Clancy Manor (10), harvest on the first floor near the fireplace, second floor in the sleeping bag room.
- Enclave research facility, harvest in holding cell Z01.
- Kanawha County Cemetery (3), harvest in a shed just to the left after passing through the entrance gate on the east side of Route 81.
- Moth-Home (6), harvest inside the shrine.
- Point Pleasant, harvest on the ground near the Mothman statue and directly west of the statue at the shrine next to the Silver Bridge.
- Sacrament (5), harvest around the shrines in the walled encampment.
- Cultist high priest pack (1-3), open for 100% chance of one mothman egg or 20% chance for three.
- Mothman nest (1 every 10m and 12s), rewarded upon completing a Spooky Scorched 2023 Event challenge.
- Liberated Collectron station - 25% chance to generate one every 9 minutes.
- Ingram Mansion (6), harvest inside the house.

- **Perfect mothman egg**

- Cultist high priest pack (5% chance)

- **Ionized crackleberry**

- Any mothman egg clutch affected by a blast zone.

- Ionized crackleberries do not exist as consumable items, and cannot be obtained.
- Mothman eggs are not sold by any vendor or found in any container by default.
- Easter egg - during the collection phase of The Mothman Equinox, players may deposit perfect mothman eggs into the Cradle of the Pretenders. Doing so will replace the vengeful mothmen with mothmen hatchlings during the defense phase. [2] 

- Prior to patch 1.0.3.10, the Green Thumb perk allowed double the Mothman eggs to be collected from each cluster.
- Unlike other eggs, mothman eggs are not classified as meat, therefore the Carnivore mutation has no effect. Despite being harvested in a manner similar to flowers, fruits, and vegetables, they aren't classified as such either and therefore the Herbivore mutation also has no effect. **[patched]** 

- The Wise Mothman is configured to drop one mothman egg upon death, but cannot be killed. [3] 
- In an earlier version of The Mothman Equinox, players would harvested enlightened mothman eggs during the collection phase. A number of these eggs would have been deposited into the Cradle of the Pretenders located behind the Mothman Museum statue. Although clutches would have held purple eggs, they yielded perfect mothman eggs which are black. [4] 

 Perfect mothman eggs do not use their custom purple reskin. [verified] [5] 

Harvested Mothman eggs

Near the Silver Bridge

At the foot of the Mothman Museum statue

Nursery/barracks at Clancy Manor

Enclave research facility
